inlines.v: OWL'ING, noun The offense of transporting wool or sheep out of England, contrary to the statute. [This explanation of owling favors the derivation of the word from wool.] OWL'-LIGHT, noun Glimmering or imperfect light. OWL'-LIKE, adjective Like an owl in look and habits.
